card.name: Social sharing footer and Darwin passage
card.fires_on: Punctuation right after 'Other social bookmarking and sharing tools' or 'Note' in ScienceDaily-style news footers. Also words inside one Darwin passage about dominant, far-spreading species.

modes.label: News footer
modes.description: The colon or dash after 'Other social bookmarking and sharing tools' and 'Note' at the end of research news articles.
modes.example: Other social bookmarking and sharing tools: Note<<:>> Materials may be edited for content and length

modes.label: Darwin species passage
modes.description: Words in a passage on dominant, varying species spreading widely and invading territories.
modes.example: It is also natural that the dominant, varying, and far-spreading species, which<< have>> already invaded to a certain extent the territories

card.plain: It fires on the stock footer line of science news pages and on one old passage about species spreading.
